name: M5.Period.quotient_cardinality
statement: ∀ F : M5.BinaryPolynomial, F.Monic → Nat.card (AdjoinRoot F) = 2 ^ F.natDegree
guidance: Use Nat.card_congr ((AdjoinRoot.powerBasisAux' hF).equivFun.toEquiv), whose target is functions Fin F.natDegree → ZMod 2. Simplify the function-space Nat.card via Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin and ZMod.card. The degree-zero case is already covered by the empty-index basis; do not add F ≠ 1 or irreducibility. Return only tactic lines without a leading by.
